Stop Guessing Your Software Costs: Why GovCon360 is Championing Usage-Based Pricing
GovCon360 Pricing Philosophy

Let's be honest: the government contracting world is already confusing, tricky, and complex enough. Between navigating federal regulations, decoding hundreds of pages of RFP requirements, and building competitive teaming arrangements, winning federal business takes immense focus and resilience.

As a small, minority-owned business ourselves, we know exactly what it feels like to be in the trenches. We know the pressure of managing a pipeline, and we intimately understand the barriers smaller firms face when trying to scale.

That is exactly why we built GovCon360. Our mission has always been to simplify the GovCon lifecycle so you can focus your energy on what actually matters: winning.

But as we built our platform, we looked around the GovCon software industry and realized something incredibly frustrating. The software meant to help contractors grow was actually holding them back. The pricing models were confusing, complex, and fundamentally broken.

So, we decided to do something about it. Here is why GovCon360 is breaking the mold with a totally transparent, usage-based pricing model and exactly how it puts the power back in your hands.

The 5 Broken Rules of GovCon Software Pricing

If you have ever shopped for business development or market intelligence tools in the GovCon space, you have likely run into one or all of these five massive roadblocks:

Opaque, Call for Quote Pricing: Most enterprise GovCon platforms refuse to publish their prices. You are forced into extensive sales calls and bespoke negotiations where the price mysteriously fluctuates based on your company size, your revenue, or how well the vendor thinks they can out-negotiate you. It makes comparison-shopping and projecting your Total Cost of Ownership nearly impossible.
Feature Gating: This is one of the most unfair tactics in the industry. Small and growing businesses get locked out of the best AI, intelligence, and pipeline features simply because they cannot afford the massive upfront cost of an enterprise-tier subscription.
The Shelfware Problem: Federal contracting is cyclical. Traditional models force you to pay expensive enterprise-level prices during your slow months when your team is focused on contract execution rather than aggressive bidding.
The Two Extremes Trap: Contractors are stuck between two bad options. You either have to buy an incredibly expensive, bloated all-in-one suite that takes months to implement, or you try to stitch together a chaotic web of disjointed, niche add-on tools leaving you with decision paralysis.
Too Complex: Ultimately, the cognitive load of navigating all these complex, secretive options leads to delayed decisions or worse, abandoning the purchase entirely and going back to messy spreadsheets.

We realized that for GovCon360 to truly be a partner in your growth, our pricing needed to reflect your reality.

The Solution: Pricing Built for Your Actual Workload

We want you to picture yourself utilizing our platform with absolute clarity on what you are paying for and why.

To solve the problems of the industry, GovCon360 utilizes a per-seat, usage-based capacity model. Instead of gating our best tools behind a massive paywall, every user gets access to our premium features from Day 1. The cost of your seat is simply dictated by the volume of your workload.

Users choose between two highly transparent tiers, billed on standard quarterly or annual contracts:

Tier 1: The Small Business Tier
Who it's for: Solopreneurs and small teams managing a highly focused, low-volume pipeline.
How it works: You pay a highly affordable, accessible rate for your seat. You get access to the platform's incredible tools, but your workspace has strict capacity limits tailored to a smaller workload, what we affectionately call the Rule of 10.
The benefit: If you hit your limit, you are not automatically charged more. You are in total control. You can simply practice good pipeline hygiene by deleting, archiving, or moving old data to free up space for new pursuits. You manage your budget on your terms.
Tier 2: The Premium Bundle
Who it's for: Established firms, enterprise capture managers, and fast-growing teams running high-volume, aggressive bidding operations.
How it works: A premium rate that entirely removes the friction of capacity management. You can scale operations, save unlimited data, access unlimited historical depths, and export freely without ever hitting a ceiling.
Total Transparency: What Do the Limits Look Like?

We believe in 100% transparency. If you choose the Small Business Tier, here is exactly what your capacity limits look like per user:

Market Intelligence: You are capped at 10 active saved searches per user, and 10 CSV or PDF data exports per quarter. You also get access to the last 15 years of historical award data, while Premium gets unlimited historical depth.
Lead Prospector: You can hold up to 10 active leads in your Lead Workspace at any given time.
Business Development: You can save 10 specific agency or vendor profiles, save 10 contacts, and manage up to 10 active deals in your Opportunity Workspace simultaneously.
Teaming Partnerships: You can collaborate on 10 active bids with external partners in our Teaming Workspaces, and send 10 partner match inquiries per quarter.
If you are an 8(a), HUBZone, or SDVOSB hunting in a specific niche, tracking 10 active opportunities at a time is exactly what you need. You get the exact same enterprise-grade pipeline and intelligence tools as the largest prime contractors, but you only pay for the capacity you are actually consuming.

But what happens when your business booms? Or when a capture manager builds a complex search filter and wants to instantly share it across the entire team so everyone is hunting from the same data pool? That is an enterprise-level motion. Shared Searches are reserved for the Premium Bundle, which immediately monetizes team alignment while keeping costs incredibly low for smaller, solo users.

Focus on Winning, Not Your Software Bill

When you log into GovCon360 on the Small Business tier and try to add that 11th active opportunity to your pipeline, you will hit your limit.

We do not want you to feel penalized in that moment. We want you to feel empowered.

Hitting that limit is a tangible milestone. It means your pipeline is growing, your strategy is working, and your business is successfully scaling. At that moment, you can choose to clean up older deals to make room, or you can look at your thriving business and confidently decide to upgrade. Upgrading to Premium is not a penalty — it is a celebration of your growth.

As a fellow small business, we built GovCon360 so you would never have to guess your software costs again. We eliminated the hidden fees, tore down the paywalls hiding the best features, and put the power of scale directly in your hands.

Stop paying for software complexity. Start focusing on winning.
